## Summary

A one-sentence description of the feature.

## Motivation

Why is this useful? What problem does it solve or what use case does it enable?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to see. If you have thoughts on the API (tool name, parameters, return value), include them here.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about and why you prefer this one.

## Additional context

Links, screenshots, kRPC docs, or other relevant information.
